features.quote: Max 15 turns per run. Terminates early if:
Agent produces identical output 3 turns in a row (loop detection)

features.justification_quote: This keeps cost predictable and prevents context-length confounds

features.quote: Judge disagreement logging: When judge confidence < 0.6, flag for human review automatically.
features.justification_quote: Don't let low-confidence calls silently contaminate your dataset.

features.quote: Adversarial disclosure: If publishing, note that this benchmark could be used to deliberately induce degradation in deployed agents.
features.justification_quote: The induction methods (especially Condition X) are effectively a recipe for breaking agents.
